start.title: Starting the Puzzle
start.description: You look at the switches on the wall. There are sixteen of them arranged in order. They're even neatly labeled. Remembering the words on the pedestal, you take a deep breath and hope for the best.

end.title: You did it!
end.description: After toggling the sixteen switches, you find yourself back in your room. You can't remember how you got here, but you know you must have done it. Somehow.

stage.title: Switch [#]
stage.description: You move to switch number [#]. The question is, do you toggle it, or move on to the next one?

fail.title: Failed
fail.description: As you move, the stone slams shut, plunging you into absolute darkness. You hear a sound like sand falling, and realize the walls are shifting. Without a way out, you are trapped. You never wake up, a forgotten casualty of the dark.
